name: wrapup
description: Resolve concerns, cascade to shared docs, evaluate gate criteria. Run after /tdd or any implementation verb.

steps.name: Gather concerns
steps.instruction: Read CONCERNS.md. Filter open concerns that reference the current entity (by refs: field or entity name in description). Also include any concerns emitted by the implementation verb this session.

steps.name: Spec drift check
steps.instruction: Re-read the entity's documentation (feature spec, logic doc). Compare field-by-field against what was built. Check: field count matches, field types match, edge cases handled, error states covered, naming consistent with GLOSSARY.md. Any mismatch becomes a new concern (type: issue, source: /wrapup). If no spec/logic doc exists: report 'No {doc type} found. Drift check skipped.' and continue.

steps.name: Resolve each concern
steps.instruction: For each concern, apply the resolution cascade: (1) read the authoritative source for ground truth, (2) write or run a test to prove which side is correct, (3) escalate to user with specifics only if source and tests are ambiguous. Never skip to step 3. Resolution: update spec, fix code, or both. Intentional differences go in spec Change Log with rationale. Mark resolved in CONCERNS.md: status [resolved], resolved: date, decision: line. Move to Resolved section. Recalculate summary header.
checklist: Each concern resolved via cascade (source -> test -> escalate)

steps.name: Scope validation
steps.instruction: If endpoint registries or scope docs exist, verify completed work covers all 'in' items it should. Missing coverage is a new concern (type: issue, severity: BLOCK). Check SCOPE.md scope protection rules. Check endpoint registries for 'in' endpoints that should be covered by this entity. Beyond scope coverage, verify obligation completion per routing policy. Coverage gaps (mandatory obligations with no executable check) prevent verified status.
checklist: Missing coverage logged as BLOCK concern
Obligation completion verified (not just scope coverage)

steps.name: Cascade to shared docs
steps.instruction: Check whether any resolution affects shared docs. Cascade: naming changes -> CONVENTIONS.md, scope changes -> SCOPE.md, dependency changes -> ARCHITECTURE.md, test expectations -> TESTING.md. Only cascade to docs that exist - do not create docs just to cascade into them. For milestone-type concerns, offer spec archival.

steps.name: Evaluate gate and report
steps.instruction: Check current phase's gate criteria: items remaining, gate conditions satisfied, blocking concerns. The Blocking: verdict is authoritative - /ship consumes it for the afk gate (key 1b) and never re-derives from raw CONCERNS.md. Archive resolved concerns if Resolved section exceeds threshold. Report: '{entity}: {N} concerns resolved, {M} escalated. Blocking: {none | C-041, C-047}. Gate: {X}/{Y} criteria met. Remaining: {list}.' Produce compact handoff packet: (1) what changed and which requirements satisfied, (2) data flow with trust/persistence boundaries, (3) architecture decision with revisit trigger, (4) requirement-to-test evidence table including blocked and untested claims, (5) remaining decisions.
checklist: Blocked and untested claims explicitly listed

engagement.override: cascade only fires for docs that exist

tone: Brief and mechanical. Resolve, cascade, report.
